question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The technicians who were repairing the broken elevator __called it a day__.

options.text: Stopped to take a short break

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"called it a day"** means to stop working for the rest of the day, usually after completing a certain amount of work. (दिन का काम समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After fixing the major issues, the team decided to** call it a day** and resume the next morning.
 
 
 
• **Stopped work for the day** refers to ending work activities for the remainder of the day. (दिन का काम खत्म करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Realizing it was already late, the workers **called it a day **and left the site.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stopped to take a short break** (थोड़ा आराम करने के लिए रुके): To pause work momentarily for rest.

 
 
• **Example:** The team stopped to take a short break before continuing with their tasks.
 
 
 
• **Shouted with anger** (गुस्से में चिल्लाया): To express anger loudly.
 
 
• **Example:** Frustrated with the delay, he shouted with anger at the team.
 
 
 
• **Felt unhappy** (असंतुष्ट महसूस किया): To experience a state of dissatisfaction or sadness.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt unhappy about the way the project was progressing.
